summary: Walks a doubly-owned linked list of memory regions rooted at the sentinel off_5E7968 to test whether address a1 falls strictly inside a region. If found and a1 is 16-byte aligned with a page offset >= 0x100, stores the owning region node into *a2 and the page-aligned base into *a3, then returns a derived address; otherwise returns 0. On-frame-path allocation/ownership validation helper.

operations.description: Walk the region linked list starting at the sentinel off_5E7968; continue while a1 is not strictly inside the current node's bounds (node[4] at +0x10 as start, node[5] at +0x14 as end): while (a1 <= node[4] || a1 >= node[5]).
If the walk returns to the sentinel off_5E7968, the address is not owned by any region: return 0.
Accept only 16-byte-aligned addresses with a page offset >= 0x100: (a1 & 0xF) == 0 && (a1 & 0xFFF) >= 0x100.
Store the owning region node into *a2 and the page-aligned base (a1 & 0xFFFFF000) into *a3.
Compute and return the derived address: ((a1 - pageBase - 256) >> 4) + pageBase + 8.
Fallback return of 0 when the address is unaligned or below 0x100 within its page.
